samples.summary: New `isCountableMergeSpan` malformed-span guard has no test anywhere
samples.evidence: This delta adds `isCountableMergeSpan` (merging.ts:120-129) and calls it as the first gate in `buildMergeCoverMap` (merging.ts:~183), with a doc comment claiming a span whose `rs` is undefined/a string/a fraction would otherwise slip past every cap and poison the running total (NaN totals make all later budget comparisons pass). No test constructs such a span. I grepped `**/*.{test,spec}.ts` for `NaN`, `isCountableMergeSpan`, `buildMergeCoverMap`, and `rs: (0|-|NaN|undefined)`; the only hits in sheets are `packages/sheets/test/sheet/merge.test.ts` comments. That file's stored-map tests (lines 61-104) cover only oversized spans, the entry cap, and malformed *keys* — every seeded span is a valid `{rs, cs}` pair. `packages/frontend/tests/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store-merge-budget.test.ts` only exercises the writer side with well-formed spans. So if this guard is removed or inverted, every suite stays green while a peer-written map with `rs: NaN` (or `rs: '2'`) disables the whole budget for that reader — the unopenable-tab failure the budget exists to prevent.

samples.summary: The 'newly straddles because the move shifted it' branch of `moveStraddlingFreeze` is untested
samples.evidence: `moveStraddlingFreeze` refuses when a block's post-move range crosses the freeze and its pre-move range did not; the sheet.ts comment claims this covers both a block carried across the line and one whose cells are shifted under it. Both new tests (packages/sheets/test/sheet/merge.test.ts:1167 and packages/backend/src/api/v1/worksheet-structure-axis.controller.spec.ts:442) are ALLOW cases, and the only REFUSE tests (merge.test.ts:1147, controller spec:399) move the merged block itself (src range contains the anchor). No test exercises a block outside the moved range that the shift window slides across the boundary (e.g. frozenRows 2, block A3:A4, move row 1 to index 10 → block becomes A2:A3, straddling). A regression that only checked blocks intersecting the move source would pass the whole suite.
searchedFor: grep merge-move-frozen across packages/sheets/test and packages/backend/src

samples.summary: No test pins the breadth of the already-straddling exemption (a straddling block that the move itself carries)
samples.evidence: The exemption compares each block with itself before/after, so a block that already straddles is skipped even when the move relocates it to a different straddling position (e.g. frozen rows 2, block A1:A4, moving rows 1-4 elsewhere). The two added tests only cover a straddling block the move never touches (merge.test.ts:1167; controller spec:442). Nothing asserts what happens when the straddling block is inside the moved range, so the intended scope of the relaxation is unpinned and could silently widen or narrow.

samples.summary: Frontend cross-sheet formula resolver's switch to `buildMergeCoverMap` (incl. an unchecked `as Array<[Sref, MergeSpan]>` cast) has no test
samples.evidence: sheet-view.tsx:1242 replaces the hand-rolled cover-map walk with `buildMergeCoverMap(Object.entries(ws.merges ?? {}) as Array<[Sref, MergeSpan]>)`. Grepping packages/frontend/tests for `sheet-view` returns only document-detail-lakehouse-tab.test.tsx, and yorkie-cross-sheet.integration.ts has zero matches for merge/frozen/freeze. So no test covers covered-ref→anchor folding in the cross-sheet resolver, nor the clamped behavior on a hostile merge map — and frontend has no `tsc` lane, so the unchecked cast is also unverified. A regression here silently returns the wrong cell value in cross-sheet formulas.

verdict.reason: `isCountableMergeSpan` (merging.ts:130-139) gates `buildMergeCoverMap` at merging.ts:179, and no test anywhere constructs a span that fails it. I enumerated every `{ rs:` literal in all `packages/**/*.{test,spec}.{ts,tsx}` files: every seeded span is a positive-integer pair. `packages/sheets/test/sheet/merge.test.ts` (read in full) covers the oversized span (62-77), the entry cap (79-88) and malformed *keys* (90-103, the parseRef/round-trip branches at merging.ts:183-194), never the span-shape branch. `packages/frontend/tests/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store-merge-budget.test.ts` exercises only the writer with well-formed spans. The closest candidate, `packages/backend/src/yorkie/worksheet-settings.spec.ts:76` (`rs: 0` rejected), exercises `parseMerges` (worksheet-settings.ts:122-162), an independent writer-side validator that does not call the reader guard. Repo-wide grep for `isCountableMergeSpan|buildMergeCoverMap` finds no test file at all. Impact is major: with the guard removed or inverted, `mergeBudgetAdmits` computes `NaN` cells, every cap comparison becomes false, and the reader's budget is disabled for the rest of a peer-written map — the unopenable-tab failure the budget exists to prevent — in both readers (Sheet.rebuildMergeCoverMap and the frontend resolver at sheet-view.tsx:1242), with every suite still green.
